items.title: Aramco Power Performances | Episode 12 - Built for the Big Stage | Women's T20WC 2026

tags.title: Latest Videos ICC Women's T20 World Cup, 2026

fields.description:
Incredible feats from the stars of the game showed that they were truly Built for the Big Stage.  
  
More on these sensational performances at the ICC Women's T20 World Cup in the latest episode of Aramco Power Performances.
